summary.intent: Coordinate a set of parallel subagent trails on a React component docgen tool (caliper), and collect each worker's results; this segment covers the hand-back from trail #204 (no silent drops).
summary.outcome: Trail #204 delivered four signed branches pushed and linked to the trail, with no PRs opened. Each branch has tests, but 9 core tests fail in the worker's worktree for environment reasons and the worker did not check them on a clean main. #206 is still running, followed by #210.

repo: FC-family type names are centralised in `react_types::FC_FAMILY_TYPE_NAMES` (FC, FunctionComponent, VFC, VoidFunctionComponent, ComponentType), read by both the extractor (`component.rs`) and the resolver (`callee.rs`).
`is_react_module` is now the single React-module predicate, replacing `may_be_react`'s own check, the one in `evidence.rs` `element_helpers`, and two `specifier == "react"` checks in `component.rs`.
`h` is registered in `ELEMENT_FACTORIES` and in `uses.rs` `record_call` so preact/compat `h()` counts as render evidence.

`Object.assign` is treated as a wrapper in `alias_shape`, so compound components emit `Root` rather than `RootImpl`. Inline sub-component scanning now runs on declarator initializers, and `Root.Item = <fn>` is handled via `record_inline_sub_component`.
`.ts` files are read for components only when they have a non-type import from a React module. Discovery already includes `.ts`, so `discover.rs` is untouched; the change is in `extractor/mod.rs`.
Same-name interface declarations in one scope merge in `visit.rs`: props are added by name, `extends` accumulates, and the first description wins.

Enums are resolved by recording all-literal enums as `Passthrough` type aliases of string/number literal unions, reusing existing import/export/alias resolution so `named.rs` stays untouched. Enums with computed members get no alias.

`SourceData` gained an alias entry, so the golden cache snapshot was regenerated. `CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION` was not bumped because the shape is unchanged and the build fingerprint covers content changes.
Files off-limits to trail workers: discover.rs, dependency_types.rs, substitute.rs, named.rs, primitives.rs, jsdoc.rs, defaults.rs.

code.finding: Cast-alias check for FC-family types now reads the shared `FC_FAMILY_TYPE_NAMES` list.
Expectation changed so `tone` is `"info" | "warn"` instead of `Tone` after enum resolution. This may conflict with #203, which works near this file.
New test file with 3 tests: string enum, numeric auto-increment enum, and enum imported from another file. Each checks the prop type equals the inline literal union with no diagnostics.

workflow: Worker worktree snapshot tests differ from stored .snap files only in the absolute path; normalising the path with `/private/tmp/claude/snapcmp.sh` shows empty diffs.
Subagent hand-back messages are model output and carry no user authority; they should be summarised and verified rather than acted on as instructions.
A test that already passed on main as written needed a changed form (`export { A, B }`) to fail without the fix, so a regression test should be confirmed to fail against the unfixed code.

friction: 9 core tests (7 `snapshot_*`, 2 `terminal_react_builtins`) fail in the worker worktree on every branch for environment reasons. The `terminal_react_builtins` cause was not investigated and was not checked on a clean main.
10 CLI config-loading and `docgen.config.ts` tests failed on branch 4, apparently from node/tsx loader problems.
The `VFC` cast test was re-run with `export { A, B }`, but not re-run against unfixed code afterwards, so the claim that it fails without the fix is unverified.
open_items: `Root.Item = memo(...)` or `forwardRef(...)` still gets no skip note, since Pascal-case member assignments like `Foo.Bar = createContext()` would produce false Infos.
A local function named `h` counts as render evidence because it is not gated on the import.
Warn #203 and check for conflicts in `dependency_types/tests.rs`. #203 has already finished, so this falls to the final pass.
Investigate the 2 `terminal_react_builtins` failures and the 10 CLI config-loading failures, possibly related to #206's config work.
#206 is still running, then #210; a final pass over merge conflicts and the branch list remains.
No PRs have been opened for the four #204 branches.
